method: 读出候选断言的源码断言体，判断其实际断言的行为是否覆盖条款语义。
被引断言必须在该基线的执行收据中明确出现且为通过（主批次 verification-batches.json，或本批为此单独执行的 covering-batches*.json）。
本文件只记录判读结论，不改矩阵 tests 指针，不提升任何行状态。

judgments.clause: Task supports zero or many Runs;
judgments.coveringAssertion: TaskRunService atomically rolls back a Run and a newly created Legacy Task when capture fails

supportiveAssertions.name: [M27-P4-T005] Bridge retry and failure stay isolated from P3 compatibility rows and Registry evidence

judgments.rationale: 两句都有直接断言：零 Run —— 快照服务失败时断言 listByTask(task.id).length === 0（Task 存在而 Run 数为 0）；多 Run —— 同一 Task 下断言 listByTask 返回两条 Run（initial/completed 与 retry/failed）。
judgments.currentPointer: apps/server/src/store/Identity.test.ts（内容为 ULID 身份测试，不覆盖本条）

judgments.clause: Run and Process can be queried independently;

supportiveAssertions.name: INSP-12 Run, Stage, Provider, Process and duration stay distinct

judgments.rationale: 断言体：对已插入 runtime_processes 的 Run 做 inspect，断言 projection.processes.length===1 且带独立 processId 与 nativePidEvidenceOnly。配合 INSP-12 的身份区分断言，证明 Run 与 Process 作为两个独立投影实体可分别查询。
judgments.limits: 这是投影层证据（Inspector 端口），不是「两个独立 repository 查询 API」的直接断言；若要求更严格的 repository 级独立性，需要补一条针对 RunRepository/ProcessRepository 分别查询的断言。

judgments.clause: non-Git Workspaces report `not-git` without silent fallback;
judgments.coveringAssertion: non-Git directory yields the exact C-locale NOT_GIT snapshot

supportiveAssertions.name: a truncated discovery diagnostic on a non-Git directory fails closed as UNAVAILABLE, never NOT_GIT

judgments.rationale: 断言体：非 Git 目录得到**精确的托管 C-locale NOT_GIT 快照**（不是静默回退到别的状态）；第二条进一步断言诊断被截断时**失败为 UNAVAILABLE 而非 NOT_GIT**，即不允许用不完整证据冒充 not-git。两句直接覆盖「如实报告 not-git、无静默回退」。
judgments.currentPointer: apps/server/src/services/WorkspaceAdmissionAuthority.test.ts（属准入子系统，不覆盖 Git 观测）

judgments.clause: diff Artifacts are immutable and checksummed;
judgments.coveringAssertion: L1C-M1-20 canonical diff Artifact crash ordering forbids DB-first availability
judgments.rationale: 断言体：规范 diff Artifact 的提交门为 canCommitCanonicalDiffArtifactV1({contentAvailable:true, immutableFinalContentExists:false}) === false（内容可用但不可变终态不存在时不允许提交），并断言崩溃策略 failureBeforeCommit/crashBeforeDatabaseCommit/crashAfterDatabaseCommit 三态，最后一条为 'database_never_points_to_missing_final_content'。即 diff Artifact 必须落在不可变终态、且 DB 永不指向缺失内容。
judgments.limits: 断言覆盖「不可变终态门禁与崩溃顺序」；未看到对 diff 内容做校验和（hash）字段的断言，若规范要求校验和字段本身，需要补一条。

judgments.clause: historical Worktree fields and Events remain readable;
judgments.coveringAssertion: WorkflowDefinitionRepository selects and exposes exact V2 metadata
judgments.rationale: 断言体：对历史（legacy key）工作流定义调用 findLatestAvailableByKey 后断言 payload.schemaVersion===2 且 **payload.worktreeMode==='preferred'** —— 即历史记录的 worktree 字段仍可被正常读出并保真。
judgments.limits: 覆盖「历史 worktree 字段可读」；条款并列的「Events remain readable」在本断言中未直接体现，若需要应补一条历史 Event 读取断言。

judgments.clause: no automatic or destructive Git command is executed by observation;
judgments.correctedFrom: 本批初版误判为 rejected（只看了集成测试文件）；复核 p6-l1c 契约套件后改判 accepted，并把过程记录在此。
judgments.coveringAssertion: L1C-M1-04 GitCommandPort accepts only structured read families

supportiveAssertions.name: L1C-M1-03 command execution contract freezes C locale and side-effect guards

judgments.rationale: 断言体：GitCommandPort 只接受结构化读族（family: repository_root 等）；测试显式构造 family: 'reset' 与携带 raw argv:['push'] 的请求，并标注 @ts-expect-error 「mutation command families are intentionally unrepresentable」「raw argv is intentionally unrepresentable」。配套 L1C-M1-03 冻结副作用守卫：GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS:'0'、GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT:'0'、pagerDisabled:true、externalDiffDisabled:true。即观测路径在类型层就无法表达破坏性命令，且运行时环境禁用了副作用来源。
judgments.limits: 「mutation 族不可表达」是**编译期**保证（@ts-expect-error 由 typecheck 而非本收据的运行时断言验证）；运行时收据证明的是结构化读族请求可被正常执行。两者合起来才覆盖该条款。

judgments.clause: Git observation wording never implies AgentOS-owned Git workflow.
judgments.candidateAssertion: truncated stderr diagnostics never prove NOT_GIT and no raw diagnostic reaches the public snapshot
judgments.rationale: 断言体保证的是「原始诊断不外泄」，不覆盖「措辞不得暗示 AgentOS 拥有 Git 工作流」这一类**文案/接口措辞**约束；全仓检索未找到措辞层面的断言。按缺口记录。
